messages:
Ashley (EnergyGrid): hey everyone :wave: excited to kick off onboarding for EnergyGrid. High-level goals: integrate Redwood API for automatic outage summaries, 2) embed customer logs for faster retrieval, and ramp to ~1k req/day by end of month. POC is me (Ashley). Can we confirm owners and a 30/60/90 milestone plan?

Marta (CSM): thanks Ashley — I’ll own success ops. :+1: Can we get an initial kickoff call this week? Also noting renewal uplift depends on first-month accuracy >90%.

Leo (Solutions Eng): landing here — I’ll lead integration work. Quick Q: will you use generation (chat) for summaries or embeddings + reranker? Both work, but pipeline differs. Also need sample traffic shape (avg tokens / day).

Ashley (EnergyGrid): leaning toward chat for human-readable summaries + embeddings for search. Sample: ~5k daily logs, average 350 tokens per log, historical 3 months (approx 5GB). Region requirement: EU-west.

Priya (Enablement): we’ll run two enablement sessions: 1) dev integrator walkthrough (day 3), 2) ops runbook + alerts (day 14). I’ll provide a short checklist for pre-work and a recording.

Tom (CS Director): flagging a potential renewal risk: data residency + auditability. Marta, please capture compliance owners and if we need Private / VPC deployment.

Marta (CSM): noted. Ashley — does your legal/security require a private deployment or is VPC + KMS sufficient? Also capturing success criteria now: - Real-time summaries <2s P50, - Accuracy >90% on our test prompts, - Stable 1k req/day with <1% error rate.

Ashley (EnergyGrid): VPC w/ KMS should be fine — no full on-prem needed. Go-live target: end of month (2026-04-30).

Leo (Solutions Eng): ok. Proposed technical milestones (short):
```
Week 1: creds, allowlist, smoke test (auth + sample curl)
Week 2: ingestion + embeddings pipeline, basic evals
Week 3: latency tuning, canary & monitoring
Week 4: go-live + post-launch support
```
I'll post a sample curl for auth now.

Leo (Solutions Eng): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"Summarize outage"}'` — please test from your infra and confirm egress rules.

Marta (CSM): I’ll spin up the kickoff invite. Need final participant list (eng lead, security, infra, product). Proposed times: Thu 10am or Fri 3pm CET — which works?

Ashley (EnergyGrid): Thu 10am CET works for me. Attendees: Ashley, Marco (Eng lead), Lena (Security), Priya, Leo, Marta.

Priya (Enablement): I’ll prepare the pre-read: short runbook + test prompts. Link to draft coming shortly.

cal-bot: Meeting created: Thu 10:00 CET — "EnergyGrid Redwood Onboarding Kickoff". Calendar invite sent to participants.

Marta (CSM): next steps from CS side: I’ll collect network allowlist, sample logs (S3 link), and legal contact for data residency. Will drop items in the meeting pre-read. Any other risks to flag now?

Ashley (EnergyGrid): potential risk: tokenization causing hallucinated timestamps in summaries — will include a curated prompt set for eval.

Marta (CSM): perfect — I’ll add that to the evaluation checklist. See you Thu. :rocket:
